story: Topanga State Park is located in the Santa Monica Mountains within Los Angeles County, California. Covering 11,000 acres, it is considered the largest park located in the limits of a city. The park features sedimentary sandstone rock formations, coastal sage scrub, and montane chaparral and woodlands.
matters: The park is part of the Santa Monica Mountains National Recreation Area and is home to over eighty mammal species as well as many migratory and resident bird species.
name: Topanga State Park
